detail.longDescription: Part one of my Proxmox Backup Server series takes us from no real backup strategy to 3-2-1. That means PBS on ZFS, Proxmox VE and Docker hosts backing up locally with the PBS client, and a pull sync job to S3 compatible storage offsite. PBS deduplicates chunks across snapshots, so nightly backups only send what changed. https:// techhut.tv/proxmox-backup-serv er-complete-guide # Proxmox # Homelab # SelfHosted
